- [ASSISTANT_SAID] In the 1980s and 1990s, the Opry evolved by embracing the "country-pop" subgenre, which included elements of pop and rock.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Opry's willingness to embrace new music styles and technologies has allowed it to remain relevant and appealing to audiences of all ages over the years.
